consigna: Friday, spoken: summarise out loud, for two minutes, something you read or listened to recently, and say what you think of it. Note two or three ideas first.
requisitos: The main point first (week 14, practised again in week 40)
Two pieces of advice for the listener (week 27)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Read the corrections from weeks 26 to 33. Write down the most frequent one and the correct form next to it.
*Wed (5 min).* Write four sentences that avoid that mistake.
*Fri (5 min).* Record two minutes, then listen.
autochequeo: Did the main point really come first?
Did the tense shift correctly in reported speech?
Was the advice usable, not vague?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of three skills at B1 level: summarising, giving advice, and reported speech. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well.
